site.title: IndieHub
site.short_description: Indie product launch directory. Paid Basic and Pro listings with dofollow links and no reciprocal badge. OpenQuok fills step 1 (Details); you pay and publish on IndieHub.
site.long_description: IndieHub lists indie products with icon, cover image, categories, and markdown intro. Every plan is paid — see IndieHub pricing (Basic $4.9, Pro $9.9). Listings publish after checkout with dofollow links to your site and no badge requirement. OpenQuok autofills Details (step 1) after you sign in; payment and publish stay on IndieHub.

opportunities.title: Basic launch
opportunities.approval_time_hint: Publishes after Basic checkout on step 3
opportunities.cost_note: $4.9 one-time on https://indiehub.best/pricing — dofollow listing, no reciprocal badge.
opportunities.description: Pay $4.9 for a Basic listing on IndieHub pricing. OpenQuok fills submit step 1 (Details) after you sign in. Finish payment on step 2 and publish on step 3. Dofollow links, no badge required.

steps.title: Compare Basic and Pro
steps.body: Read what each tier includes on https://indiehub.best/pricing before you checkout.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.body: Open https://indiehub.best/auth/login and sign in with GitHub, Google, or email.

steps.title: Fill Details
steps.body: Open https://indiehub.best/submit. On step 1 (Details), use OpenQuok to fill link, name, categories, tags, description, intro, icon, and cover image. Skip IndieHub AI AutoFill if it prefills your URL. OpenQuok does not autofill payment or publish.

steps.title: Pay Basic
steps.body: On step 2 (Payment), choose Basic ($4.9) and complete checkout on IndieHub.

steps.title: Publish and verify
steps.body: On step 3 (Publish), submit the listing. Open your live IndieHub product page and confirm the dofollow website link. Save your live listing URL.

opportunities.title: Pro launch
opportunities.approval_time_hint: Publishes after Pro checkout on step 3
opportunities.cost_note: $9.9 one-time on https://indiehub.best/pricing — more dofollow links and placement vs Basic.
opportunities.description: Pay $9.9 for Pro on IndieHub pricing. Pro adds stronger placement and more dofollow links than Basic. OpenQuok fills submit step 1; checkout and publish stay on IndieHub.

steps.title: Compare Basic and Pro
steps.body: Confirm Pro benefits (extra dofollow links and visibility) on https://indiehub.best/pricing.

steps.title: Fill Details
steps.body: Open https://indiehub.best/submit. Use OpenQuok on step 1 only. Skip AI AutoFill URL prefill when needed.

steps.title: Pay Pro
steps.body: On step 2 (Payment), choose Pro ($9.9) and complete checkout.

steps.title: Publish and verify
steps.body: Publish on step 3. Open your live listing and confirm each dofollow link to your site. Save your live listing URL.
